card.name: The word glass before water
card.fires_on: The word "glass" after "a" or "drinking" when a drink of water is being described, mostly in dosing instructions. Weaker on a few word endings in ingestion or milliliter terms.

modes.label: Glass of water
modes.description: "glass" as a drinking container right after "a", before "of water" or a measured amount of liquid.
modes.example: Swallow the capsule whole with a<< glass>> of water.

modes.label: Ingestion word endings
modes.description: The ending of words about swallowing or liquid volume, such as ingestion, ingested and milliliters.
modes.example: OVERDOSAGE Accidental Oral Ingest<<ion>>- Selenium Sulfide Topical Suspension

card.writes: It seems to push toward container and vessel words such as cup, bowl and "ule" endings, and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It lights up on "glass" in "a glass of water" when taking medicine.
